StateTree.Comment: Grinding subtree for Mage bots on their own (run by STAI_NonCombat_Autonomous_Mage.xml): pulls the closest safe unit of a fitting level, else walks to a spawn point of such units in the spawn group LevelingProvider picked for the bot's level (another group, or zone, once grinding there stops paying); the fight is the Combat tree's

Task.Comment: where to level: zoneId / zoneName for the bot's level, huntArea (the spawn group to grind there, no elites around), xpPerHour; another group / zone when one pays less than a level per 45 minutes
what to hunt: pullTarget (closest safe unit of a fitting level), huntLocation (a spawn point of such units further away), onPullTarget

Task.name: Pull Range
Task.Comment: movement goal: in spell range and sight of the unit to pull

Task.name: Hunt Area
Task.Comment: movement goal: to the hunt area, then its next spawn point, while there is nothing to pull

State.name: Pull
State.Comment: the opener: once it is cast the unit fights the bot and the Combat tree takes over

State.name: Search
State.Comment: walking to the unit or the hunt location: Pull once the Pull Range goal arrives; selects again every second (a failed Pull, or an arrival before this state started, fires no delegate)
